CheckTitle: Firewall blocks NetBIOS/SMB ingress from the internet
Description: Linode Firewalls are checked to ensure they block **NetBIOS/SMB** (port(s) [137, 138, 139, 445]) ingress from the internet (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0).
Risk: Allowing unrestricted NetBIOS/SMB access from the internet exposes services to **brute-force attacks** and **exploitation**.
